_comment: Pitch + roll/heading + speed blocks on c172x with heading steps; all three are consumed by sim_ext. Yaw/structure stay off (no dynamics yet). Task definition (ramp 600 fpm with 0.1 g corners, feed-forward, steps) from the shared Phase-1 set.

_heading_hold_note: Shared heading_hold is on (bank clamp 16 deg, heading I-limit 10 deg) but this preset evolves the full roll_heading block and keeps its own track_heading term, so the Phase-1 track_heading_rms term is set to 0 here.
